name: Buttons designed specifically for 5G feature phones
introduction: These buttons are designed for 320×480 feature phones, prepared for models such as TCL508n, Coolpad Jinshiji y60, Baihe A89, Yiqing feature phones and the like. Why prepare buttons like these? Because these phones have far too small a resolution and the keys are hard to set up; if you set up the D-Pad yourself it flies all over the place while you drag it. Although the layout looks a lot like the official one, this is a new layout rebuilt key by key to fit feature phones. It is a simple layout where you can add whatever keys you need. Below are the sensitivity and other settings for feature phones: sensitivity 550, window resolution 145 to play smoothly! Right now feature phones cannot open the input method directly in-game; you can tap input, add what you want, then tap what you typed - a bit slow, but it still works qwq
